purpose: Method-independent benchmark contract; pipeline placement is selected by matched evidence rather than fixed before evaluation

raw_harmonized.input: Observed aligned diploid microarray GTs; retain observed allele identity and missingness policy
raw_harmonized.phase_independent_methods: Compatible when fitted to this exact observed-marker and missingness contract
raw_harmonized.FLARE_Gnomix: Not direct inputs: both require phased haplotypes; do not invent phase from allele order

array_phase_only.invariants: No added variants, filling of missing GTs or changed supplied diploid GTs

phased_imputed.input: Statistically phased and imputed genotypes with declared retained-marker and QC policy
phased_imputed.invariants: Verify observed GT preservation separately; report imputed marker accuracy on known-truth controls; do not conflate DS with hard GT
phased_imputed.FLARE_Gnomix: Permitted, not presumed preferable; evaluate matching models and references

inherited_phase.input: Original simulator/reference phase on the same selected marker panel
inherited_phase.role: Mechanistic diagnostic, not a deployable processing stage or winner-selection shortcut

paired_comparison.people: Same predeclared identities and known truth in each processing track; masks, phase conditions and chromosomes are not independent extra people
paired_comparison.labels_and_exclusions: Same source definitions, pedigree truth, training/reference/evaluation donor exclusions and imputation-reference exclusion manifest
paired_comparison.panels: Same exact marker panel across methods within a stage; stage-native panels may differ and must have coverage/filters reported. Use matched-panel ablations to separate stage from marker-content effects.
paired_comparison.truth: Same realized physical-base-pair ancestry across full half-open chromosome spans; never replace truth with retained SNP counts
paired_comparison.aggregation: Posterior fractions using physical midpoint cells and equal paired-copy weights; common output schema
paired_comparison.methods: Report native estimates separately from learned calibration; document different training budgets and method-specific parameters
paired_comparison.selection: Use donor-purged training evidence to choose configurations, lock finalists before development reporting; no tuning to a real individual's expected answer
paired_comparison.completion: Require all22 autosomes and exact subject/method/stage coverage before a global comparison; preserve failed evidence and record explicit recovery annexes

stage_selection: Prefer validated accuracy, tails and reproducibility; retain source/pure guardrails and report resource trade-offs. Do not infer an optimal placement from different people, reference identities or incomplete cohorts.
scope: Current14-person observed-array pilot remains development-only; historic partial imputed experiments are not comparable completed tracks and are not silently resumed
